title: From If-Statements to ML Pipelines: Revisiting Bias in Code-Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to generate code for predictive ML pipelines and conditional statements, then calculating the Code Bias Score (CBS) by using an LLM-based extraction pipeline to measure the proportion of generated functions that explicitly include 'race' as a predictive feature.
